title: Food grain production of a district
body: A district statistical office recorded the production of two food grains, in thousand tonnes. In the base year 2010 the district produced 40 thousand tonnes of rice and 60 thousand tonnes of wheat. In 2020 it produced 58 thousand tonnes of rice and 72 thousand tonnes of wheat. A geography student wants to show the change in the total production of the two crops together with a single index number, taking 2010 as the base year with a value of 100, and using the simple aggregate method: index = (sum of current-year production / sum of base-year production) x 100.

title: Monthly electricity use of households
body: In a field survey, a group of students recorded the monthly electricity consumption (in units) of 40 households in their locality and grouped the readings by the exclusive method. The frequency distribution was: 0-50 units: 6 households; 50-100 units: 10 households; 100-150 units: 13 households; 150-200 units: 8 households; 200-250 units: 3 households. The total number of households, ∑f = N, is 40. The students then prepared a cumulative frequency column by adding each simple frequency to the sum of the frequencies before it.
